resolutions.note: The reader was right: "a legitimate Rembrandt" is exactly "genuine and not a copy", so legitimate was a second defensible answer. This pool teaches authentic and legitimate as separate items with separate senses, so the fix keeps the stem and drops the overlapping distractor: legitimate is replaced by tentative.

Not a sheet flag but a reader’s note: this item and vocab-g912-inevitable carried a word-for-word identical definition, so a child who meets both is asked the same question with two different keys. This one now reads "impossible to get around or prevent"; vocab-g912-inevitable keeps "certain to happen and impossible to avoid".
